contents.text: Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. We're at the top of the page, where it says your doors close at five and your website doesn't. An agent like me answers the question a customer asks at eleven at night, and leaves their details for you in the morning.

arguments.question: Shall we carry on down the page?

choices.label: On to: It takes them to the right place
choices.why: The first of the four things it does for every visitor.

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name.

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick it up another time.
